title: DeleLuz — Local lighting controls
brief: Five responsive directions for a local-first BLE RGB-IC strip controller. Compare device control, groups, color, effects, custom modes, pixel editing, and optional music.

artboards.title: Control Deck
artboards.tradeoff: Target and connection are visible beside controls; denser on small screens.

artboards.title: Strip Canvas
artboards.tradeoff: Direct LED selection; its main feature is preview-only until the protocol is confirmed.

artboards.title: Quick Scenes
artboards.tradeoff: One-tap daily presets; deeper controls take another action.

artboards.title: Mode Studio
artboards.tradeoff: Time and transitions are explicit; manual control is less prominent.

artboards.title: Rooms & Groups
artboards.tradeoff: Partial connection and delivery are visible per strip; adds structure for single-strip owners.
